home.description: Paragliding and speedflying sites in the HPGT area (Harstad, Northern Norway). Filter by wind direction, level and category.
home.title: Where is the wind today?
home.suggest: Only sites that may work now
home.rulesSummary: How are wind and rain assessed?
home.rules: Rough assessment from the MET forecast for the launch: more than {maxWind} m/s (or the site's own limit) or gusts above {maxGust} m/s is too much. Light wind, missing gusts, gusts more than {maxGustSpread} m/s above the mean wind, a direction near the edge and light rain (from {rainMaybe} mm in the next hour) give “uncertain”. Rain ({rainNo} mm or more in the next hour) gives “not suitable”. The forecast does not see local conditions. Always check for yourself.
home.resultsNote: A rough guide: every pilot decides for themselves whether the site and conditions are OK. More under Info.

home.disclaimer: This overview is a rough guide to flying sites in the HPGT area. The club takes no responsibility for information about safety, airspace or landowner agreements. Every pilot and student decides for themselves whether the site and conditions are OK.
home.credit: The site builds on the old site guide by Lars Sletten, which he has given to the club.

site.windgramIntro: Wind at heights above the launch, hour by hour. The colours show wind strength (m/s): green suitable, yellow near the limit, red too much. The arrow shows where the wind blows. “Boundary layer” is roughly how high thermals can go, and the cells above are faded. The dashed line with a cloud is the estimated cloud base. Grey columns are dark.
site.windgramSource: Model data from Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0). Rough: the model does not see the local terrain, and the cloud base is estimated from temperature and dew point at ground level.
